title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, board chair
gist: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and chairman 11 days after he resigned amid scandals including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy and allegations Nvidia subverted China export controls, citing US government assurances of no national security risk and strong backing from President Trump. Nvidia stock, down ~25% since the resignation and ~50% from its October peak, jumped ~30% in early trading; multiple government investigations remain ongoing.
